description.value: Tickleberry's at Skaha Park is a seasonal ice cream and sweets kiosk at Skaha Beach in Penticton, part of a beloved Okanagan chain operating since 1990. The shop scoops over 150 flavors of hand-crafted ice cream alongside house-made fudge produced in an on-site Fudge Factory, chocolate-covered dried fruits, and local gifts. For touring cyclists on the Skaha Lake corridor, it's a quintessential lakeside sweet stop with quick takeout service geared toward people ready to roll.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record 'Tickleberries at skaha park' maps to the 'Skaha Beach' branch listed on tickleberrys.com, a multi-location Okanagan ice cream and sweets business. The website explicitly states 'Skaha Beach Closed for the season – See you this summer!' confirming this is a seasonal location, currently closed at time of data collection. Takeout is confirmed by the website's description of cones, dishes, and napkins for customers 'in a hurry to hit the road again'; a vegan ice cream flavor ('Vegan Peanut Butter Brownie') is explicitly listed in the menu, confirming vegan options.
concerns: Skaha Beach location is explicitly listed as 'Closed for the season – See you this summer!' on the website; this is a seasonal operation currently closed at time of data collection.
OSM name 'Tickleberries at skaha park' differs from the brand spelling 'Tickleberry's'; the website refers to this location as 'Skaha Beach', not 'skaha park'.
No address available for the Skaha Park location specifically; the website contact page address (PO Box 570, Hwy 97, Main St., OK Falls, BC V0H 1R0) belongs to the main Okanagan Falls location.
URL discovery confidence rated 'medium'; the fetched website confirms a Skaha Beach location exists but does not provide a dedicated URL or street address for it.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, long-running seasonal ice cream shop at a popular lakeside park on a well-traveled cycling corridor; a natural and appealing stop for touring cyclists in the Penticton/Skaha Lake area.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business operates three locations: Okanagan Falls (main/year-round), Skaha Beach/Penticton (seasonal), and Downtown Penticton. The phone number (+1-250-497-8862) and email (tickleberrys@gmail.com) shown on the website appear shared across all locations.
